title: "Usage margin"

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/reports/usage_margin"}
#docs
A line with no full cost is counted in `lines_without_cost` and left out of revenue and cost. One row per group and currency; currencies are never added together. Needs `usage_margin:view`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | `string · ISO-8601` | **yes** | Start, inclusive (RFC 3339). |
| `to` | `string · ISO-8601` | **yes** | End, exclusive (RFC 3339). At most 366 days after `from`. |
| `group_by` | `string` | no | Default `customer`. |
| `currency` | `string` | no | One currency only. |
| `customer` | `string` | no | One customer's id (cus_…). |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `usage_margin`. One of `usage_margin`. |
| `group_by` | `string` | The usage margin's group by. One of `customer`, `model`, `meter`. |
| `from` | `string · ISO-8601` | The usage margin's from. |
| `to` | `string · ISO-8601` | The usage margin's to. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.customer` | `string` | The customer's id (cus_…). |
| `data.customer_name` | `string` | With `group_by=customer`: the customer's name, else its email. |
| `data.model` | `string` | The pricing model. |
| `data.meter` | `string` | The usage margin's meter. |
| `data.currency` | `string` | The usage margin's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `data.revenue_minor` | `integer` | After discounts and credit notes, before tax. |
| `data.cost_minor` | `integer` | The cost in minor units (integer), e.g. 2900 = $29.00. |
| `data.margin_minor` | `integer` | The margin in minor units (integer), e.g. 2900 = $29.00. |
| `data.margin_percent` | `string` | The usage margin's margin percent. |
| `data.lines` | `integer` | The usage margin's lines. |
| `data.lines_without_cost` | `integer` | The usage margin's lines without cost. |
| `totals` | `array of object` | The usage margin's totals. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The margin per group and the totals per currency. |
| `400` | The range is not correct. |
| `404` | No such customer. |

